Guilford Native American Association

An identity-only outline for the agency-listed Guilford Native American Association. The NC Department of Administration describes it as a Native American community association in Guilford County. Only a coarse North Carolina setting is selected; fuller relationships, historical context and annotated reading remain unassessed.

A museum account of material selection

Greensboro History Museum says members of the Guilford Native American Association chose display materials to highlight different cultures and perspectives within the Triad Native American community. The release offers a limited, attributed example of material selection for a museum display. Community-authored perspectives and reuse permissions remain unassessed.
